title: Manus announces it is resuming independent operation under its founders after China's regulator blocked Meta's acquisition
summary: HK01 reports the 1 September announcement; Meta had completed the deal in December 2025 for over USD 2B and China's NDRC ordered it revoked in April, and Manus warned users of possible data backup needs and temporary access interruptions.
src: https://global.hk01.com/即时中国/60385733/中国叫停meta收购案后-manus恢复独立运营-原创始团队继续掌舵

title: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, with more permissive cybersecurity mitigations, through its Fairwind Program
summary: Wikipedia's Gemini entry says the Cyber variant is available through Google's Fairwind Program rather than generally.

title: Nvidia announces it will acquire Hugging Face for USD 12.93B, saying the platform will stay open and not require Nvidia hardware
summary: TechCrunch reports closing is expected in the first half of 2027 pending regulatory approvals; The Information had reported the agreement on 26 August.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra to approved users first, with general availability the next day
summary: Wikipedia's ChatGPT entry says Greg Brockman describes Astra as an early AGI and that it is partly based on looped transformers.

title: Anthropic accuses Moonshot AI of routing requests to Claude via proxy servers and training on the responses, citing 5,380 accounts and 23M+ exchanges
summary: The allegation is Anthropic's; Wikipedia's Moonshot AI entry places the proxy servers in Singapore and Japan and cites the September threat report.

title: Anthropic's September threat report says it disrupted misuse of Claude by actors it links to Russian state espionage and to Chinese-speaking intrusion groups
summary: The report covers December 2025 to August 2026; Anthropic says no misuse involved Fable or Mythos-class models apart from one distillation case, and the attributions are Anthropic's own.

title: DeepSeek presents V4.1-Flash, its most compact and fastest model, with native multimodal input, Rozetked reports
summary: Rozetked's page shows no date; the 10 September date comes from Wikipedia's DeepSeek entry, which adds that DeepSeek claims lower memory use from a causal encoder-decoder design.

title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls the exponential pace of AI development 'a warning sign that we need to slow down'
summary: CBS News carried the remarks of 12 September, listed on Wikipedia's entry on existential risk from AI.

title: Sam Altman confirms OpenAI's IPO is delayed until 2027
summary: Wikipedia's OpenAI entry lists the confirmation under September 2026 without a day.

title: US Department of Defense makes customised versions of ChatGPT and Grok available to personnel on GenAI.mil
summary: Wikipedia's Grok entry lists the rollout under September 2026 without a day.

title: FBI, NSA and CISA advisory alleges six Chinese AI developers used distillation attacks to extract capabilities from US models
summary: The advisory names DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.ai and alleges activity since 2024; Wikipedia dates it only to September 2026 and the allegations are the agencies'.

title: Elon Musk urges top AI labs and Chinese companies to test each other's models, CNBC reports
summary: The remarks of 15 September came amid calls for a slowdown, per Wikipedia's entry on existential risk from AI.

title: Nvidia reportedly agrees to acquire Taiwanese chip designer MediaTek in a USD 110B cash-and-stock deal pending regulatory approvals
summary: Wikipedia's Nvidia entry says 'reportedly' and gives September 2026 without a day.

title: OpenAI announces a framework for tracking and disclosing unsafe AI behaviour, with six worked examples
summary: Wikipedia's OpenAI entry dates the announcement to 16 September 2026 and gives no further detail.

title: California Governor Newsom signs an executive order to speed up two AI safety laws, possibly including an AI 'kill switch', Politico reports
summary: The order of 18 September is listed on Wikipedia's entry on existential risk from AI.

title: Trump says he will create an 'AI Force' and name an AI czar while rejecting calls for new constraints, saying bad AI would be policed under existing law
summary: The Washington Post report of 19 September is listed on Wikipedia's entry on existential risk from AI.

title: OpenAI's Sora API is scheduled to end on 24 September, javadex.es lists
summary: The Spanish digest, published in April, gives 24 September as the end date for the API after the app closure; it does not confirm the shutdown happened.

title: Russia's first AI law (No. 243-FZ) enters into force, with AI-content labelling and sovereign/national model rules applying from March 2027
summary: The federal law on supporting AI technologies took effect on 1 September 2026, starting support measures for developers of sovereign and national models, while labelling of AI-generated content and developer obligations start on 1 March 2027.

title: Ecuador National Assembly education committee recommends archiving a proposed AI law, saying it over-regulates the technology
summary: The Assembly's education committee recommended not advancing a proposed artificial intelligence law, finding that the text over-regulates the use of AI.

title: Putin tells the Eastern Economic Forum that Russia's AI goals are sovereignty in certain segments and developing cooperation
summary: Speaking at the Eastern Economic Forum plenary, Vladimir Putin called AI one of the country's most important areas and said the aims are to ensure sovereignty in a certain segment and to develop cooperation.

title: Sber releases GigaChat 3.5 Reasoning under the MIT licence, calling it the first Russian open model with a reasoning mode
summary: Sber released GigaChat 3.5 Reasoning, trained with online reinforcement learning, free for developers under the MIT licence and available to all GigaChat users, with reported gains on IFBench, Natural Plan and LiveCodeBench.

title: OpenAI confirms to AFP that it, Anthropic and Google DeepMind are working to create a body to oversee AI risks
summary: OpenAI told AFP that the three labs are working on an AI risk oversight body, following Demis Hassabis's July proposal for a largely industry-funded self-regulatory entity modelled on FINRA.

title: Huawei launches the Ascend 960 supernode at Huawei Connect 2026 and pulls forward its Ascend 960DT and 960PR chips
summary: Huawei said the Ascend 960 supernode scales to 4,096 cards with 8 EFLOPS FP8 for 10-trillion-parameter models, and moved the Ascend 960DT to Q1 2027 and 960PR to Q3 2027, ahead of plan.

title: Alibaba CEO Eddie Wu targets over 20GW of Alibaba Cloud data-centre capacity by 2032 and unveils T-Head's Zhenwu V900 AI chip
summary: At the 2026 Yunqi Conference, Wu said Alibaba will train 5 to 10 trillion-parameter models, T-Head launched the Zhenwu V900 with three times the M890's performance, and Alibaba Cloud aims to exceed 20GW globally by 2032.

title: Honor says its Magic9 phones will be the first to ship Alibaba's Qwen Intelligence agent solution
summary: At the Yunqi Conference, Honor said the Magic9 series launching on 28 September will be the first official phones with Alibaba's Qwen Intelligence, reporting 91.8% task accuracy on phone GUI operations.

title: Amodei tells the UN Security Council Anthropic will slow development 'as much as necessary'; Altman says AI progress needs 'extreme care'
summary: In a UN Security Council session, Anthropic's Dario Amodei pledged by video to reduce Anthropic's pace of development as needed, while OpenAI's Sam Altman said rapid progress requires extreme care.

title: Xi proposes to Trump at the White House that AI development stay under human control; Teleamazonas reports talks on an AI communication channel
summary: During Xi Jinping's White House visit, Xi said both countries must ensure AI development always stays under human control, and preliminary talks between the US Treasury Secretary and He Lifeng discussed a channel for AI concerns.
